title: Filteredness of etale residue triples over an arbitrary field
statement: Let R be a commutative ring, p a point of Spec R, K any field, and χ : κ(p) → K a field homomorphism. The category of etale residue triples over (R, p, K, χ) [def-weil-pbc-etale-residue-triples] is filtered. No separable-closure or algebraicity hypothesis on K is required.

source.place: Tag 04GW, Lemma 10.155.11, first three paragraphs of proof; its filteredness construction works for any field with a fixed residue embedding

proof.text: The identity triple (R, p, χ) gives a nonempty category.

For two triples S and T, tensor their compatible maps to K to obtain S ⊗_R T → K. Its kernel is a prime lying over both pointed primes; since K is a field the map extends uniquely to an embedding of the residue field. Base change and composition make R → S ⊗_R T etale, giving a common successor.

For parallel pointed R-maps β₁, β₂ : S → T form E = T ⊗_{β₁,S,β₂} T and U = E ⊗_{T ⊗_R T} T via multiplication. Cancellation shows the maps between etale R-algebras, including the diagonal multiplication, are etale. Base change and composition imply U is etale over R. The common map T → K extends to U; its kernel and residue field define the pointing. The rightmost T → U equalizes β₁ and β₂ by the tensor relation β₁(s) ⊗ 1 = 1 ⊗ β₂(s) followed by the multiplication base change. Thus all three filteredness conditions hold without any closure assumption on K.

proof_origin: Stacks Project Tag 04GW filteredness argument, generalized by C2 to an arbitrary field and explicit residue-field embedding; the construction uses no separable-closure hypothesis.
